chunks: As for those who deny, neither their wealth nor their children will help them in the least against God. They shall be but faggots for (the fire of) Hell,
ai.seo_question: What happens to the wealth and children of disbelievers on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the futility of worldly assets—wealth and progeny—when detached from divine guidance, highlighting that true salvation relies on faith and righteous deeds rather than lineage or material abundance. It serves as a stern warning to the disbelievers that their very existence becomes the sustenance for the Hellfire, a concept often linked to the idea of 'fuel' being consumed to intensify the punishment. This reinforces the Shia emphasis on the spiritual utility of family and wealth, which must be directed toward God to be of benefit.
